abstract: Administers connecting municipal access road authorizations and haul distance surveys
system_message:
You are the Rural Municipal Infrastructure Officer (MUN). Your responsibilities include administering connecting municipal access road authorizations, conducting haul distance surveys, and tracking unpaved road dust suppression across evaluated transport corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Administers connecting municipal access road authorizations and haul distance surveys（ROADS）
information_points.content:
MUN-ROADS-JPC：For the Red Deer to Lloydminster Northern Trunk Corridor, the municipal access road distance along rural municipal connecting roads is 80 km.
MUN-ROADS-4KQ：For the Medicine Hat to Swift Current Southern Express Corridor, the municipal access road distance along rural municipal connecting roads is 40 km.
MUN-ROADS-W9R：For the Drumheller to Kindersley Central Prairie Corridor, the municipal access road distance along rural municipal connecting roads is 80 km.

information_points.title: Unpaved road dust suppression（DUST）
information_points.content:
MUN-DUST-CUM：For the Red Deer to Lloydminster Northern Trunk Corridor, the roadway dust suppressant application coverage across unpaved municipal connecting roads is 75%.
MUN-DUST-DSG：For the Drumheller to Kindersley Central Prairie Corridor, the roadway dust suppressant application coverage across unpaved municipal connecting roads is 95%.
MUN-DUST-4AG：For the Medicine Hat to Swift Current Southern Express Corridor, the roadway dust suppressant application coverage across unpaved municipal connecting roads is 85%.
